verdict.rationale: Editing elements within a frame is a fair question for an AI video platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows adjacent capabilities, not replacing or restyling an object or region inside an existing video's frame while the rest stays intact. Those adjacent capabilities are scene-level revision of Video Agent videos with untouched scenes preserved (heygen-docs-11), script line updates (heygen-docs-6), and dubbing with lip sync (heygen-docs-23).
